# Third-party notices

[lemmings-opl](../crates/lemmings-opl/README.md) contains the fixed integer core derived from `nuked-opl3 0.1.0` / Nuked-OPL3 1.8. Copyright (C) 2013-2020 Nuke.YKT; Copyright (C) 2026 Tony Gies (Rust port). It is **LGPL-2.1-or-later**. The [complete license](../crates/lemmings-opl/LICENSE), preferred source and modification/relinking instructions accompany it. Include them with copies containing this engine.

Optional Unicorn and original C verification binaries remain outside project dependencies/distributable applications. Their licenses/source hashes and execution scope are recorded in [#76 provenance](../mydocs/tech_insights/issue-76_opl_pcm.md). The evaluated `oplon` core was not selected after independent original-music acoustic comparison.

G10-05 web builds provide a visible footer notice, local LGPL text, corresponding source/relink archive and source/WASM hashes. The archive includes current library/application source and pinned build files; extracted sources support library modification and rebuilding without Git. Native source builds include the notices and relink materials in this repository.
